title: Order Credits Taken Off a Missing-Information Correction — Insurance Coverage & Claims Desk Guidance
content:
**Desk guidance — Insurance Coverage & Claims, missing-information corrections (CO-16).** Credits posted on the patient's order under **Laboratory Test Orders** can come off the amount a missing-information correction carries. The order is the order the corrected claim bills; its credits are the test charge credits on that order, each with its credit reason.

## Rule

The order's credits enter the missing-information correction only when the order's most recent credit was posted after the claim's filing date:

- where any credit on the order is for a **test not performed** or a **duplicate test**, every credit on the order comes off;
- where the order carries **billing-correction** credits only and their total reaches the missing-information correction's credit minimum, the billing-correction credits come off;
- otherwise nothing comes off.

"After the filing date" means on a later calendar day: a credit posted on the filing date itself is not after it. When the order has no credit at all, nothing comes off.

## Cases (hypothetical orders)

| Most recent credit on the order | Credit reasons on the order | Billing-correction total against the credit minimum | What comes off |
|---|---|---|---|
| After the filing date | Test not performed 85.00 and billing correction 6.00 | — | Every credit, 91.00 |
| After the filing date | Duplicate test 40.00 | — | 40.00 |
| After the filing date | Billing correction 30.00 only | Reaches the credit minimum | 30.00 |
| After the filing date | Billing correction 3.00 only | Below the credit minimum | Nothing |
| On or before the filing date | Test not performed 85.00 | — | Nothing |

## Points of judgement

- Only the date of the order's **most recent** credit is compared with the filing date; once it is later, earlier credits on the order are counted too.
- A test-not-performed or duplicate-test credit brings every credit on the order off, billing corrections included, with no minimum.
